name: Barley
notes: Cycle: FAO-56 Table 11 winter wheat values (180-240 d) applied to autumn-sown barley; the FAO small-grains Mediterranean value (150 d) is for April sowing and not used. Water: R-02. Residue level assumes straw is baled and removed (usual in rain-fed Andalusia); high if stubble/straw is left (direct drilling).
